todos.description:
Consolidate duplicate documents: move canonical versions of candidate_materials.md, characterization_techniques.md, literature_review.md, roadmap.md, synthesis_methods.md, theoretical_framework.md into docs/, remove root duplicates, and update README.md links to point to docs/ versions.

Also (council-synthesis): Reconcile inconsistent Tc and pressure values for predicted room-temperature superconductors (YH10, CaH12, MgH16) between proposed_chemistry_physics.md and docs/candidate_materials.md, using a single authoritative source.

Also (council-synthesis): Add detailed synthesis protocols for YH10, CaH12, MgH16 in proposed_chemistry_physics.md, or cross-reference docs/experimental_protocol_hydride.md with specific parameters.

Also (council-synthesis): Update theoretical_framework.md to include sections on electron-phonon coupling (McMillan-Allen-Dynes), strong correlations (DMFT), and unconventional pairing (spin fluctuations), referencing proposed_chemistry_physics.md.

Also (council-synthesis): Fix broken link in README.md (discovery_strategy.md) by moving root discovery_strategy.md into docs/ and updating the link, or updating the link to point to root.
Implement predict_tc function in scripts/predict_tc.py using McMillan-Allen-Dynes equation, loading from data/superconductor_database.json.

Populate data/superconductor_database.json with real entries for known and predicted superconductors (LaH10, H3S, YH9, YH10, CaH12, MgH16, etc.) including composition, pressure, Tc, electron-phonon coupling λ, Debye temperature.
Write unit tests in tests/test_predict_tc.py that mock the database and verify expected Tc values for known materials (e.g., LaH10 at 170 GPa → ~250 K). Remove duplicate tests/tests_predict_tc.py.
